Hedge is a Jira Cloud Risk management app for anyone who needs to register, assess, and prioritize risks in Jira. It also allows monitoring progress and linking risks to a company’s day-to-day work.
Hedge provides a complete and engaging risk management tool for Jira Cloud, and offers a set of predefined industry-standard risk management templates from which to choose.
Six steps to get you started with Hedge
Install the app from the Atlassian marketplace.

Why is Risk issue type not available in my team-managed project?

When you install Hedge, it creates a custom Risk issue type in your Jira instance. This issue type is added to all your company-managed projects. Due to Jira limitations, it's not done automatically in team-managed projects. You must

content.text: If you’re unable to see your imported risks in the Risk Register, you may have filters or issue limitations blocking their visibility. To fix this, clear unnecessary filters and make sure the correct issue types are selected.
If you have a different project, issue type, or any other parameters applied in the filters that don’t match your risks, you will be unable to see your risks. To fix this:
Reapply filters, making sure to only apply filters that match the parameters of your risks.

On the next pages, you’ll learn more about how Hedge makes risk management easier and more collaborative. Starting from creating and customizing risk registers to better reflect your business needs, to scoring risks flexibly across Hedge and Jira, and finally gaining insights through available reports.
Whether you're scoring risks in Hedge or directly within Jira, your data stays perfectly in sync, giving your entire organization access to consistent, up-to-date risk information you can trust.

With Hedge, you can create risk registers customized for different teams, projects, or compliance needs. Each one reflects your unique risk framework, whether for IT, Finance, or Operations.
